notes.title: Patch v0.0.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is the patch v0.0.5 that includes:

-New drops added.

-Drop earning hours have changed.
      *Normal Drop: 30 minutes
       *Middle Drop: 3 hours
       *Rare Drop : 20 hours

-New achievement added

* Time is reset if you quit the game
* The sale of rare products will be activated after 36 hours.

❗️Don't forget to get updates to access new drops.❗️
